MONDO:0003990.text: An invasive malignant tumor that arises from the breast. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped myoepithelial cells. Mitoses are present. Rarely, local recurrences and distant metastases have been reported.

MONDO:0003991.text: A primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of numerous finger-like villi lined by neoplastic columnar cells.

MONDO:0003992.text: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in children. The tumor arises from organs with a mucosal epithelial surface. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules within an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003993.text: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in female children. The neoplasm arises from the vagina. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003994.text: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from the vagina. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules within an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003995.text: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in female children. The neoplasm arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003996.text: A disease involving the basal ganglia.

MONDO:0003997.text: A Kaposi sarcoma arising from the colon.

MONDO:0003999.text: A pilocytic astrocytoma that occurs during adolescence.

MONDO:0004000.text: A pilocytic astrocytoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004001.text: Elevated pressure in a confined space enclosed by fascia or eschar, which may lead to vascular compromise and subsequent ischemic injury to the tissue within the space.

MONDO:0004004.text: Inflammation of the peripheral motor nerves.

MONDO:0004005.text: An adenoma that arises from the rete ovarii. It is composed of elongated tubules. The clinical course is benign.

MONDO:0004006.text: An exceptionally rare cystadenofibroma that arises from the rete ovarii.

MONDO:0004007.text: A group of non-invasive epithelial proliferations that occur in the ductal system of the breast. The vast majority of cases arise in the terminal ductal lobular units. This category includes atypical ductal hyperplasia, usual ductal hyperplasia, flat epithelial atypia, and ductal carcinoma in situ. There is an increased risk for subsequent development of invasive breast carcinoma.

MONDO:0004008.text: A breast lesion characterized by the presence of dilated terminal ductal lobular units in which the epithelial lining has been replaced by a single layer of mildly atypical cells, or there is atypical, monotonous epithelial hyperplasia of three to five layers. This lesion relates to columnar cell change with atypia and columnar cell hyperplasia with atypia.

MONDO:0004009.text: An infiltrating transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the renal pelvis and exhibits sarcomatoid features.

MONDO:0004012.text: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in adults. The neoplasm arises from organs containing a mucosal epithelial surface. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0004013.text: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from the vagina. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma. It occurs in female adults.

MONDO:0004014.text: An extremely rare meningioma that arises as a primary ectopic tumor in the ethmoid sinus.

MONDO:0004015.text: A mature or immature teratoma that arises in the pineal region.

MONDO:0004019.text: A primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of eosinophilic malignant glandular epithelial cells.

MONDO:0004020.text: A mediastinal lymphoma with molecular, morphologic, immunophenotypic, and clinical features of both mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphoma and classical Hodgkin lymphoma. The identification of this group of lymphomas, along with recent gene expression profiling results (PDL2 gene expression in both mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphoma tissues and Hodgkin lymphoma cell lines), further supports the hypothesis that mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphomas and classical Hodgkin lymphomas are related entities.

MONDO:0004021.text: A lymphoma that arises from the mediastinum. Representative examples include mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphoma and Hodgkin lymphoma.

MONDO:0004022.text: A meningioma that affects the superior sagittal sinus and invades the parasagittal angle.

MONDO:0004024.text: A neuroblastoma that affects the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004026.text: A small, benign growth that arises from the skin. It is characterized by the presence of fibrovascular tissue lined by epidermis. It may be sessile or pendulous and usually occurs in sites where there is friction.

MONDO:0004028.text: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the small intestine. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0004030.text: A carcinoma that arises from the transitional epithelium of the ureter. It is associated with tobacco use and usually presents with gross or microscopic hematuria.

MONDO:0004032.text: A malignant mixed epithelial neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed predominantly of serous and endocervical-type mucinous epithelium.

MONDO:0004034.text: A lymphoma that involves the eye.

MONDO:0004035.text: A benign multifocal proliferation of glomus cells forming clusters around dilated vascular spaces.

MONDO:0004038.text: Deficiency in the enamel tissue that results in the formation of grooves, pits, or dents on the surface of the affected teeth.

MONDO:0004040.text: A neoplasm of the bladder in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue, which often causes hematuria.

MONDO:0004041.text: A rare benign condition, characterized by a papillary growth in the urinary tract with a central fibrovascular core. The latter is lined by normal urothelium.

MONDO:0004042.text: A neoplasm of the urethra in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue.

MONDO:0004043.text: A neoplasm of the ureter in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue, which often causes hematuria.

MONDO:0004044.text: A benign epithelial neoplasm that produces visible warty projections from the epithelial surface of the ureter.

MONDO:0004045.text: Retinoblastoma during childhood that has not spread beyond the eye.

MONDO:0004046.text: A brain meningioma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004047.text: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the sphenoid sinus. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include Schneiderian papilloma and salivary gland-type adenoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma and lymphoma.

MONDO:0004048.text: A malignant teratoma that arises from the stomach.

MONDO:0004049.text: Neurotic reactions to unusual, severe, or overwhelming military stress.

MONDO:0004050.text: An osteosarcoma usually arising from the metaphysis of long bones. It is characterized by the presence of a cystic architecture with blood-filled spaces. The prognosis is similar to that of conventional osteosarcoma.

MONDO:0004052.text: A carcinoma that arises from the transitional zone at the junction of the rectum and anus.

MONDO:0004053.text: A carcinoma that arises from the Bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant squamous epithelial cells.

MONDO:0004056.text: An invasive or non-invasive papillary transitional cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder. It is classified as low - or high-grade. -- 2003

MONDO:0004057.text: An infiltrating bladder transitional cell carcinoma exhibiting micropapillary growth pattern. -- 2003

MONDO:0004058.text: A rare syndrome characterized by severe watery diarrhea, hypokalemia, and achlorhydria. It is caused by the oversecretion of vasoactive intestinal peptide from the pancreatic islet cells.

MONDO:0004059.text: Pain or discomfort caused by exposure of the dentin layer of tooth to thermal, tactile, or other stimuli.

MONDO:0004060.text: An epithelioid sarcoma involving the extremities. It usually presents as nodular masses in the dermis and subcutaneous tissues or in the tendons and fascia. It frequently recurs and metastasizes to other anatomic sites. The most common sites of metastasis are the lungs, lymph nodes, bones, and brain.

MONDO:0004062.text: Uveal melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004063.text: Iris melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004064.text: A uveal melanoma that arises from the iris. It is the most common primary malignant neoplasm of the iris. The majority arise in preexisting nevi.

MONDO:0004065.text: Choroid melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004066.text: Ciliary body melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004067.text: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the gallbladder. It is characterized by the presence of extracellular mucin that constitutes more than fifty-percent of the tumor.

MONDO:0004069.text: Diseases caused by abnormal function of the mitochondria. They may be caused by mutations, acquired or inherited, in mitochondrial dna or in nuclear genes that code for mitochondrial components. They may also be the result of acquired mitochondria dysfunction due to adverse effects of drugs, infections, or other environmental causes.

MONDO:0004071.text: An astrocytoma, without designation of benign or malignant, that is found in the supratentorial region. The infratentorial location is more common in children.

MONDO:0004074.text: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by mucinous columnar epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0004075.text: A benign tumor, composed of lobules of mature adipocytes, that penetrates the surrounding tissue from which it arises. There is usually a higher local recurrence rate when compared with non-infiltrating lipomas.

MONDO:0004076.text: A benign tumor, composed of mature adipocytes, that arises within the tendon sheath.

MONDO:0004077.text: A benign well-circumscribed tumor, composed of lobules of mature adipocytes, that arises within the lumbosacral tissue of the spine.

MONDO:0004078.text: An intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma that produces abundant mucin.

MONDO:0004079.text: A benign adenomatous neoplasm that arises from the mucous glands in the bronchus.

MONDO:0004080.text: A squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the glottic area. It may remain localized for a long period then in late disease stage, it may spread to the opposite true vocal cord, supraglottic and subglottic areas, and the soft tissues of the neck. Hoarseness is the presenting symptom.

MONDO:0004081.text: A morphologic variant of extrahepatic bile duct adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelium composed of clear cells.

MONDO:0004082.text: An immature teratoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004083.text: A rare cutaneous lesion presenting as a scaly verrucous plaque. Morphologically, the plaque contains nests of basaloid cells.

MONDO:0004085.text: A epithelioid cell melanoma that involves the optic choroid.

MONDO:0004086.text: A epithelioid cell melanoma that involves the ciliary body.

MONDO:0004087.text: A morphologic variant of large cell lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of a solid nodular or anastomotic trabecular growth pattern, peripheral palisading, and comedo type necrosis.

MONDO:0004088.text: An aggressive variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of nests of malignant basaloid squamous cells with scant amount of cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004089.text: An aggressive, human papillomavirus-related squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis. It is characterized by the presence of nests of small malignant cells. The malignant cells tend to invade deeply into the adjacent tissues. Comedo-type necrosis is often present.

MONDO:0004090.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of nests of malignant basaloid cells with a scant amount of cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004091.text: A basaloid squamous cell carcinoma that involves the zone of skin.

MONDO:0004092.text: A rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of tumor cell lobules with peripheral palisading, and a basophilic staining pattern. More than half of reported cases were associated with the presence of a multilocular thymic cyst. Metastases to lung and liver have been reported in approximately 30% of cases.

MONDO:0004093.text: A rare morphologic variant of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Histologically, it is composed of closely packed cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm. It has a similar prognosis to the conventional squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus. (WHO)

MONDO:0004094.text: Multiple meningiomas that affect the skull base.

MONDO:0004095.text: A group of heterogeneous lymphoid tumors generally expressing one or more B-cell antigens or representing malignant transformations of B-lymphocytes.

MONDO:0004096.text: A dermoid cyst that involves the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004098.text: A rare variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor that arises from the mediastinum. It is characterized by the presence of malignant cells that contain melanin.

MONDO:0004099.text: A cystic teratoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004100.text: A lung carcinoma characterized by a combination of small cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0004101.text: A papillary carcinoma arising from the thyroid gland from multiple foci.

MONDO:0004102.text: A morphologic variant of papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland characterized by the presence of pseudostratified malignant follicular cells.

MONDO:0004103.text: A morphologic variant of papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland characterized by the presence of tall malignant follicular cells, arranged in papillary and trabecular patterns. Necrotic changes and high mitotic activity are present.

MONDO:0004104.text: A hairy cell leukemia that involves the spleen.

MONDO:0004105.text: An epithelioid sarcoma occurring in childhood.

MONDO:0004106.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of collections of thin-walled spaces.

MONDO:0004107.text: A leukemia (disease) that involves the spleen.

MONDO:0004108.text: A meningioma that affects the diaphragma sellae.

MONDO:0004109.text: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the epiglottis.

MONDO:0004110.text: Hairy cell leukemia that is resistant to treatment.

MONDO:0004111.text: A hematologic malignancy that is resistant to treatment.

MONDO:0004112.text: Inflammation of the bladder due to irradiation.

MONDO:0004114.text: A highly aggressive carcinoma, histologically resembling small cell lung carcinoma. In most cases it is associated with carcinoma in situ.

MONDO:0004116.text: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the esophagus. It is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

MONDO:0004117.text: An aggressive neuroendocrine carcinoma arising from the ampulla of Vater and the periampullary region. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells, necrosis, and a high mitotic rate. Signs and symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.

MONDO:0004118.text: A reactive inflammatory disorder affecting the bladder. It is characterized by the development of small cysts in the bladder wall. The cysts are lined by urothelial cells.

MONDO:0004120.text: A rare neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the Bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells and high mitotic activity.

MONDO:0004122.text: An aggressive, small cell, poorly differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma, characterized by the presence of a high mitotic rate and numerous apoptotic bodies.

MONDO:0004124.text: A rare malignant neoplasm arising from specialized prostatic stroma. It is characterized by the presence of stromal overgrowth and hypercellularity, increased number of mitotic figures, and pleomorphism.

MONDO:0004125.text: A well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the rectum. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0004126.text: Inflammation of the thyroid gland. This category includes Hashimoto thyroiditis, Riedel thyroiditis, acute thyroiditis, subacute thyroiditis, and radiation-induced thyroiditis.

MONDO:0004127.text: A lung adenocarcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. The primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

MONDO:0004128.text: A large cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. The primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

MONDO:0004129.text: An anal carcinoma arising from the transitional zone of the anal canal.

MONDO:0004130.text: An anal squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and peripheral nuclear palisading.

MONDO:0004131.text: A large, well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with a cauliflower-like appearance, characterized by the presence of an exophytic and endophytic growth pattern. Morphologically, there is papillomatosis and acanthosis present, however cytologically the neoplastic squamous cells have a benign appearance. Dysplastic changes are minimal. It does not respond to conservative treatment and it is regarded by many authors as an intermediate lesion between condyloma acuminatum and squamous cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0004132.text: A squamous cell carcinoma arising from the mucosa of the anal canal.

MONDO:0004133.text: An epithelial neoplasm of the anterior pituitary gland in which the neoplastic cells stain positive with acidic and basic dyes.

MONDO:0004135.text: Thyroiditis associated with painless enlargement of the thyroid gland. It occurs more frequently in females and is characterized by alterations between hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism and the eventual return to normal thyroid gland function.

MONDO:0004136.text: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells.

MONDO:0004139.text: Anemia in which the red blood cell volume is normal.

MONDO:0004140.text: An immature teratoma characterized by the presence of an intermediate amount of undifferentiated tissues.

MONDO:0004142.text: A subtype of large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of large neuroendocrine cells in combination with adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, giant cell carcinoma and/ or spindle cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0004143.text: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of psammoma bodies that predominate over the meningeal cells.

MONDO:0004144.text: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of spindle cells that form bundles in a collagen matrix.

MONDO:0004145.text: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of tumor cells that form lobules. The tumor cells are generally uniform. Whorls and psammoma bodies are usually not present.

MONDO:0004146.text: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the coexistence of meningothelial cells and fibrous architectural patterns.

MONDO:0004147.text: A morphologically malignant thymoma that is entirely confined within the capsule.

MONDO:0004148.text: An intraluminal papillary neoplasm, usually with high grade intraepithelial neoplasia, that arises from the gallbladder. It is associated with the presence of an invasive carcinoma. The carcinomatous component is usually an adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004150.text: A breast fibroadenoma characterized by a very large size. This term has also been used as a synonym for juvenile fibroadenoma by some authors. The latter is characterized by epithelial hyperplasia and an increased stromal cellularity.

MONDO:0004151.text: A malignant neoplasm involving the meninx of spinal cord.

MONDO:0004152.text: A recently recognized variant of chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) expressing somatic hypermutations of the Immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) genes. The recognition of this variant alters the belief that CLL/SLL is always derived from a naive, pregerminal center B-cell. The presence of somatic hypermutations of IGH genes occurs in approximately 50% of CLL/SLL cases and implies a postgerminal center, memory origin. Patients with this variant of CLL/SLL have a favorable prognosis, with a reported median survival of more than 24 years.

MONDO:0004153.text: An embryonal carcinoma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004155.text: A embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004156.text: A mucinous cystadenocarcinoma that involves the pancreas.

MONDO:0004158.text: A cystic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of columnar mucin-producing epithelial cells, ovarian-type stroma formation, and a focal or extensive invasive carcinomatous component.

MONDO:0004159.text: A non-invasive malignant cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. It occurs almost exclusively in women. Small tumors are usually found incidentally. Larger tumors usually produce symptoms related to compression of the adjacent structures. It is characterized by the presence of columnar, mucin-producing epithelial cells which often form papillary projections with irregular branching and budding. There is cellular stratification, severe dysplasia, and high mitotic activity present. Complete surgical removal is usually associated with an excellent prognosis.

MONDO:0004160.text: The involuntary loss of urine in females secondary to insufficient strength of the pelvic floor muscles; this can result from physical changes following pregnancy and childbirth, or as a response to a decrease in estrogen during menopause.

MONDO:0004161.text: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by zones of hemorrhagic infarction surrounded by hypercellular areas. It usually develops in women of childbearing years, particularly those that are pregnant, post-partum, or taking oral contraceptives.

MONDO:0004162.text: A morphologic variant of leiomyoma arising from the uterine corpus. It is characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

MONDO:0004163.text: A transitional cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder that arises from the urachal epithelium.

MONDO:0004164.text: A variant of prostate carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells forming syncytial patterns and dense lymphocytic infiltrates.

MONDO:0004165.text: A rare dysgammaglobulinemia characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of immunoglobulin class D (IgD). It is an uncommon primary antibody deficiency. It is most likely an inherited immunodeficiency. It may be caused by decreased or inefficient production of IgD from progenitor B cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. Most affected persons are asymptomatic and do not appear to be at increased risk for infection.

MONDO:0004166.text: Fallopian tube carcinoma that has developed in relatives of patients that have a history of fallopian tube carcinoma.

MONDO:0004168.text: A morphologic variant of testicular seminoma characterized by the presence of seminoma cells arranged in cribriform patterns and few lymphocytes.

MONDO:0004169.text: A combination of distressing physical, psychologic, or behavioral changes that occur during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle. Symptoms of PMS are diverse (such as pain, water-retention, anxiety, cravings, and depression) and they diminish markedly 2 or 3 days after the initiation of menses.

MONDO:0004172.text: A adenocarcinofibroma that involves the body of uterus.

MONDO:0004173.text: A rare adenocarcinoma arising from Skene gland. It presents as a periurethral or anterior vaginal submucosal mass. It is characterized by morphological features similar to prostate adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004174.text: An endometrioid adenocarcinoma arising from the endometrium. Morphologically it is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells containing glycogen vacuoles which are usually subnuclear and reminiscent of early secretory endometrium.

MONDO:0004176.text: An osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue, and occurring during childhood.

MONDO:0004177.text: Abnormal growth of the cells of the urethra (lower urinary tract) without malignant characteristics.

MONDO:0004178.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of connective tissue stalks that contain a blood vessel and are lined by cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli.

MONDO:0004180.text: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the organs that comprise the urinary system. Representative examples include renal oncocytoma, bladder inverted papilloma, and urothelial papilloma.

MONDO:0004181.text: An uncommon variant of breast adenosis characterized by the presence of irregularly shaped glands, epithelial cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, and prominent myopepithelial cells. Mild atypia may be present.

MONDO:0004182.text: Stage IV includes T4b, NO,MO/any T NI, MO/ any T N2 MO,/ any T N3 MO/ any T any N M1 : T4b: Tumor invades the pelvic wall, abdominal wall. N1: Metastasis in a single lymph node, 2 cm or less in greatest dimension. N2: Metastasis in a single lymph node, more than 2 cm but not more than 5 cm in greatest dimension; or multiple lymph nodes, none more than 5 cm in greatest dimension. N3: Metastasis in a lymph node more than 5 cm in greatest dimension. M1: Distant metastasis.

MONDO:0004183.text: Any nerve disorder affecting the axon of a nerve.

MONDO:0004185.text: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by serous epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0004186.text: A rare self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the cranium. This is an osteolytic lesion. It is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

MONDO:0004187.text: A self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

MONDO:0004188.text: A spindle cell melanoma that involves the iris.

MONDO:0004189.text: A tuberculosis that involves the esophagus.

MONDO:0004190.text: A metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urinary bladder. It is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

MONDO:0004191.text: So-called nephrogenic adenoma is a distinct metaplastic lesion of the urothelium characterized by aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells. These cells line thin papillary fronds on the surface or form tubular structures within the lamina propria.

MONDO:0004192.text: A malignant neoplasm involving the urethra

MONDO:0004193.text: A dysgerminoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004194.text: A non-neoplastic disorder that usually affects postmenopausal women. It is characterized by the leuteinization of ovarian stromal cells. The ovaries are bilaterally involved and enlarged. When it affects women in reproductive age, it causes virilization, high blood pressure, and increased insulin levels.

MONDO:0004195.text: The developmental arrest and architectural distortion of the thymus that results in immunodeficiency.

MONDO:0004196.text: A biphasic rectal carcinoma with a spindle cell, sarcomatoid component.

MONDO:0004197.text: A cancer involving a male urethra.

MONDO:0004198.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of aggregates of polygonal malignant cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli.

MONDO:0004199.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of keratin pearls.

MONDO:0004200.text: A term used by urologists to describe an infiltrating carcinoma of the bladder that has not invaded into the muscularis propria of the bladder wall regardless of histologic type or grade.

MONDO:0004201.text: Incomplete development of the pituitary gland.

MONDO:0004202.text: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the adrenal medulla

MONDO:0004203.text: A cancer that involves the female urethra.

MONDO:0004204.text: A squamous papilloma that involves the zone of skin.

MONDO:0004206.text: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the pulmonary vein. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004207.text: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the pulmonary artery It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004208.text: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the superior vena cava. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004209.text: A central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified arising from the cerebral hemispheres.

MONDO:0004210.text: A neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the colon and produces glucagon-like peptides. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.

MONDO:0004211.text: A neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the gastrointestinal tract and produces glucagon-like peptides. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.

MONDO:0004212.text: A rapidly growing squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is self-limited and is characterized by the presence of a central crater that contains squamous cells. The proliferating squamous cells infiltrate the dermis below and produce keratin masses that are pushed towards the surface of the tumor.

MONDO:0004213.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the absence of keratin pearls.

MONDO:0004214.text: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0004215.text: An anthrax disease that results in infection located in skin, has material basis in Bacillus anthracis, which is transmitted by contact with infected animals or animal products. The infection has symptom skin lesion that eventually forms an ulcer with a black center.

MONDO:0004216.text: A germinoma that arises from the pineal gland.

MONDO:0004217.text: A germinoma arising from the brain during childhood.

MONDO:0004218.text: A germ cell tumor arising from brain during childhood.

MONDO:0004219.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of collections of vesicles that are surrounded by connective tissue.

MONDO:0004220.text: A primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of spindled malignant epithelial cells.

MONDO:0004221.text: A neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation arising from the uterine corpus wall.

MONDO:0004222.text: A malignant glandular epithelial neoplasm arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of clear and hobnail cells and cystic structures.

MONDO:0004223.text: A benign polypoid growth in the middle ear.

MONDO:0004225.text: A condition characterized by the presence of a monoclonal gammopathy (MG) in which the clonal mass has not reached a predefined state in which the condition is considered malignant. Up to 25% of cases of monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS) progress to a B-cell malignancy or myeloma. MGUS may occur in conjunction with various carcinomas, chronic inflammatory and infectious conditions, and other diseases.

MONDO:0004227.text: A benign, usually asymptomatic small mesothelial tumor that arises from the epididymis.

MONDO:0004229.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by cellular discohesion resulting in a pseudoangiosarcomatous pattern.

MONDO:0004230.text: A benign neoplasm arising from mesothelial cells. It is characterized by the formation of glandular and tubular patterns. It can occur in several anatomic sites including the pleura, peritoneum, and epididymis.

MONDO:0004231.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped malignant cells.

MONDO:0004232.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells that exhibit keratinization.

MONDO:0004233.text: A rare aggressive rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in children. The neoplasm is characterized by the presence of bizarre round, spindle, and polygonal cells.

MONDO:0004234.text: An Epstein-Barr virus negative disorder with a chronic clinical course affecting predominantly adults and characterized by the proliferation of large granular lymphocytes with natural killer cell immunophenotype. The T-cell receptor genes are not rearranged.

MONDO:0004235.text: An infection that develops in the diverticula of the intestinal tract. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, fever, and leukocytosis.

MONDO:0004236.text: A somatostatin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the duodenum. It is characterized by the presence of tubulo-glandular structures.

MONDO:0004237.text: A rare poorly differentiated morphologic variant of large cell lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of rhabdoid cells.

MONDO:0004238.text: A meningioma that affects the petrous apex.

MONDO:0004239.text: A variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of keratin pearls. Intercellular bridges and cytoplasmic keratinization are usually present.

MONDO:0004240.text: A malignant neoplasm that affects the portion of the urethra that is close to the bladder.

MONDO:0004241.text: Osteochondrosis of the growth plate near the tibial tuberosity.

MONDO:0004243.text: An epithelioid sarcoma of the proximal type involving the vulva.

MONDO:0004244.text: An epithelioid sarcoma predominantly involving the pelvis, perineum, and genital organs. It tends to have a more aggressive clinical course as compared to the more frequently seen distal-type epithelioid sarcoma.

MONDO:0004245.text: A tumor arising from the ependymal lining of the ventricles.

MONDO:0004247.text: A digestive system disease characterized by discontinuation in the inner lining of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract because of gastric acid secretion or pepsin.

MONDO:0004248.text: An ependymoma that arises from the infratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004249.text: An ependymoma that arises from the supratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004250.text: An adenoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. It is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern.

MONDO:0004251.text: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the small intestine. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

MONDO:0004252.text: A neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the small intestine and produces glucagon-like peptides. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.

MONDO:0004253.text: A benign breast neoplasm characterized by the proliferation of multiple papillomas within the lumen of the ducts.

MONDO:0004255.text: A benign or malignant epithelial neoplasm of probable Wolffian origin. It predominantly arises from the broad ligament and presents as a unilateral adnexal mass.

MONDO:0004256.text: A meningioma that arises from the meninges of the lumbar region of the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004257.text: A mixed germ cell tumor that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004258.text: A sexual disorder in which a woman fails to achieve orgasm during sexual intercourse.

MONDO:0004259.text: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the endocervix.

MONDO:0004260.text: Penetration of a peptic ulcer through the wall of duodenum or stomach allowing the leakage of luminal contents into the peritoneal cavity.

MONDO:0004261.text: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells around small breast ducts.

MONDO:0004262.text: A multifocal neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within and/or around small breast ducts.

MONDO:0004263.text: An embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the infratentorial region and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004265.text: An acute, usually bacterial infection affecting the endometrium. It is characterized by the presence of neutrophils or microabscesses in the endometrial glands. Symptoms include fever, lower abdominal pain, and vaginal discharge.

MONDO:0004266.text: An anal adenocarcinoma arising from the epithelium of the anal glands. The overlying anal mucosa does not show evidence of neoplastic changes.

MONDO:0004267.text: A benign squamous neoplasm characterized by a papillary growth pattern, diffusely involving a specific anatomic site.

MONDO:0004270.text: A benign, well circumscribed neoplasm that is located within the lumen of a duct in the breast parenchyma. It is characterized by the presence of glandular structures at the periphery and fibrous tissue at the center of the tumor.

MONDO:0004271.text: A tubular type adenoma of the breast in which, during pregnancy and lactation, the epithelial cells show extensive secretory changes.

MONDO:0004272.text: A tuberculosis that involves the urinary bladder.

MONDO:0004273.text: A rare, benign and well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the breast. It is characterized by the proliferation of epithelial cells with extensive apocrine metaplasia.

MONDO:0004274.text: An invasive breast carcinoma characterized by the presence of a mesenchymal cellular component. The mesenchymal cellular component ranges from cartilaginous and osseous, to purely sarcomatous.

MONDO:0004275.text: A sarcomatous transformation of pre-existing Paget disease of the bone. Osteosarcomas arising from Paget disease of the bone are high grade lesions and usually have a poor prognosis.

MONDO:0004276.text: A benign epithelial neoplasm derived from ceruminous glands in the external auditory canal. It presents as a gray mass covered by skin. It is characterized by a proliferation of glands composed of cells with abundant eosinophilic and granular cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004277.text: A common sexually transmitted bacterial infection caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae. It is transmitted through vaginal, oral, or anal intercourse. Infected individuals may be asymptomatic. Symptoms in males include burning sensation during urination, discharge from the penis, and painful swelling of the testes. Symptoms in females include painful urination, vaginal discharge, and vaginal bleeding between periods. If untreated, the infection may lead to pelvic inflammatory disease.

MONDO:0004278.text: An invasive transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder that exhibits spindle cell sarcomatoid features.

MONDO:0004279.text: Diseases of the ninth cranial (glossopharyngeal) nerve or its nuclei in the medulla. The nerve may be injured by diseases affecting the lower brain stem, floor of the posterior fossa, jugular foramen, or the nerve's extracranial course. Clinical manifestations include loss of sensation from the pharynx, decreased salivation, and syncope. Glossopharyngeal neuralgia refers to a condition that features recurrent unilateral sharp pain in the tongue, angle of the jaw, external auditory meatus and throat that may be associated with syncope. Episodes may be triggered by cough, sneeze, swallowing, or pressure on the tragus of the ear. (Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1390)

MONDO:0004281.text: An eccrine porocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

MONDO:0004283.text: A vulvar sweat gland carcinoma characterized by the presence of clear cells.

MONDO:0004285.text: A malignant glandular neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. Microscopically it is characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation, papillary patterns, and cystic changes. It has been associated with KRAS and Tp53 gene mutations.

MONDO:0004286.text: A usually slow-growing epithelial neoplasm with ductal differentiation that arises from the exocrine pancreas and grows mostly within the pancreatic ducts. Grossly, it is characterized by the presence of intraductal masses. Morphologically, there is proliferation of mucin-producing cells within the pancreatic ducts, intraductal accumulation of mucin, and a papillary growth pattern. It may be associated with the presence of an invasive carcinoma. It usually occurs in older patients. Signs and symptoms include epigastric pain, weight loss, jaundice, chronic pancreatitis, and diabetes mellitus.

MONDO:0004287.text: A pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of adenocarcinoma cells with foamy cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004288.text: An infiltrating ductal breast carcinoma associated with stromal fibrosis.

MONDO:0004289.text: An exophytic, slow growing, well differentiated and non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma with pushing margins that arises from the glottic area of the larynx. It usually presents with hoarseness.

MONDO:0004290.text: An exophytic, slow growing, well differentiated and non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma with pushing margins that arises from the subglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0004291.text: A squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the subglottic area. Symptoms include dyspnea and stridor. It spreads to the hypopharynx, trachea, and thyroid gland.

MONDO:0004292.text: An exophytic, slow growing, well differentiated and non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma with pushing margins that arises from the supraglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0004293.text: A squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the supraglottic area. Signs and symptoms include dysphagia, a sensation of foreign body in the throat, and hemoptysis. It spreads to the space anterior to the epiglottis, pyriform sinus, and base of the tongue.

MONDO:0004294.text: A rare malignant trophoblastic tumor that arises from the ovary as a result of ectopic ovarian pregnancy. There is no germ cell component present.

MONDO:0004295.text: A carcinoma arising in the lung due to exposure to asbestos.

MONDO:0004296.text: A variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of islands of cells with uniform, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and a dense lymphocytic infiltrate.

MONDO:0004297.text: A rare, usually aggressive primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by a syncytial growth of undifferentiated carcinoma cells and the presence of a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate. More than 40% of cases are associated with Epstein-Barr virus infection.

MONDO:0004301.text: A conventional osteosarcoma characterized by the presence of spindle shaped cells.

MONDO:0004302.text: A parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly of neoplastic chief cells. These cells have either slightly eosinophilic or vacuolated cytoplasm, and round nuclei.

MONDO:0004303.text: A parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly of neoplastic cells with clear cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004304.text: A parathyroid gland adenoma that contains a mixture of neoplastic cells (chief cells, oncocytes, and clear cells).

MONDO:0004305.text: A parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly or entirely of neoplastic cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004306.text: A high grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm that produces osteoid and occurs in childhood. It arises from the medullary portion of the bone. It affects the long bones, and most commonly, the distal femur, proximal tibia, and proximal humerus. Pain with or without a palpable mass is the most common clinical presentation. It usually has an aggressive growth and may metastasize through the hematogenous route. The lung is the most frequent site of metastasis.

MONDO:0004307.text: A rare condition characterized by diffuse spread of sarcoma cells throughout the meninges. The neoplastic cells are derived from meningeal connective tissue. Clinically, this disorder may present as a fulminant pachymeningitis and/or encephalitis.

MONDO:0004308.text: A rare sarcoma arising from the meninges.

MONDO:0004309.text: The occurrence of several sarcomas in different anatomic locations.

MONDO:0004310.text: An embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered, occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004311.text: A carcinoma that involves the bulbo-urethral gland.

MONDO:0004312.text: A meningioma that affects the suprasellar region.

MONDO:0004313.text: A meningioma that affects the trigeminal ganglion.

MONDO:0004315.text: An intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the canals of Hering.

MONDO:0004316.text: A histologic variant of squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the skin. It is characterized by loosening of the intercellular bridges between the malignant cells which results in acantholysis.

MONDO:0004317.text: Multiple meningiomas that arises from the spinal meninges.

MONDO:0004318.text: An aggressive small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the ovary. Morphologically, it resembles the small cell carcinoma that arises from the lung.

MONDO:0004319.text: An undifferentiated small cell carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is associated with hypercalcemia. Electron microscopic studies show neurosecretory granules are either absent or, when present, are in small numbers.

MONDO:0004321.text: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the endometrium and is characterized by the presence of both type I and type II endometrial adenocarcinoma components. The minor component constitutes at least 5% of the entire tumor.

MONDO:0004322.text: A malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the ovary and is composed of cytotrophoblasts, syncytiotrophoblasts, and extravillous trophoblasts. The prognosis is less favorable than gestational choriocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004323.text: The loss of muscle tissue due to inactivity or disease.

MONDO:0004324.text: A benign neoplasm that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of fusiform cells and collagenization.

MONDO:0004325.text: A rare benign tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of lipid-rich neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004326.text: A benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the sphenoid sinus. It results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

MONDO:0004327.text: A papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the sphenoid sinus. It is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.

MONDO:0004328.text: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the maxillary sinus. It is classified as intestinal-type or non-intestinal-type adenocarcinoma. Nasal obstruction and epistaxis are the presenting signs.

MONDO:0004329.text: A non-invasive pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that exhibit loss of polarity, nuclear stratification, hyperchromasia, and pleomorphism. There is severe architectural atypia and frequent mitotic figures present.

MONDO:0004330.text: A sarcoma arising from the leptomeninges.

MONDO:0004331.text: A adenocarcinoma that involves the urachus.

MONDO:0004332.text: A malignant neoplasm involving the lung hilus.

MONDO:0004333.text: A malignant, ectopic ACTH secreting pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, associated with Cushing's syndrome. The prognosis is usually poor.

MONDO:0004334.text: A low or intermediate grade well differentiated tumor with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the pancreas. It is characterized by the absence of a hormone-related clinical syndrome.

MONDO:0004335.text: A disease or disorder that involves the digestive system.

MONDO:0004336.text: An infiltrating adenocarcinoma arising from the rectum. It is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells with prominent intracytoplasmic mucin. These cells constitute more than 50% of the malignant cellular population.

MONDO:0004337.text: Paget disease involving the perianal skin.

MONDO:0004339.text: A meningioma that affects the tuberculum sellae.

MONDO:0004340.text: A carcinoma that arises from the pancreas showing a mixture of ductal and neuroendocrine malignant cells in both the primary tumor and in the metastatic sites.

MONDO:0004341.text: An infiltrating pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, characterized by the presence of malignant cells floating in pools of mucin. It has a more favorable prognosis than the conventional infiltrating ductal adenocarcinoma. It often arises in association with intraductal pancreatic mucinous neoplasms and in some cases it may result in the development of pseudomyxoma peritonei.

MONDO:0004343.text: A cystic adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of relatively uniform neoplastic cells which produce pancreatic enzymes and are arranged in acinar patterns. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, weight loss, nausea, and diarrhea. It usually has an aggressive clinical course.

MONDO:0004344.text: A malignant hemangiopericytoma occurring in childhood.

MONDO:0004345.text: A malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor occurring in children.

MONDO:0004346.text: An intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma characterized by the presence of signet ring adenocarcinoma cells.

MONDO:0004349.text: A lymphoma that involves the retina.

MONDO:0004350.text: Retinoblastoma during childhood that has spread beyond the eye.

MONDO:0004351.text: A lymphoma that arises within the eye. Signs and symptoms include decreased vision, uveitis, and vitreous floaters.

MONDO:0004352.text: An ependymoma of the brain occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004353.text: A non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the extrahepatic bile ducts.

MONDO:0004354.text: Leukemia that occurs during the neonatal period.

MONDO:0004355.text: An acute or chronic leukemia that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004356.text: A cystic neoplasm which arises from the kidney and occurs in children. It includes the cystic partially differentiated nephroblastoma and cases in which nephroblastomatous elements are not present.

MONDO:0004357.text: A carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the supraglottic area.

MONDO:0004358.text: A carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the subglottic area.

MONDO:0004359.text: A disorder characterized by the presence of one or more nonbizarre delusions that persist for at least 1 month; the delusion(s) are not due to schizophrenia or a mood disorder, and do not impair psychosocial functioning apart from the ramifications of the delusion(s).

MONDO:0004360.text: An osteosarcoma arising from the breast tissue.

MONDO:0004361.text: An ependymoma of the spinal cord occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004363.text: A rare spinal tumor which is highly malignant and tends to be locally invasive of surrounding neural tissue. The tumor also tends to spread throughout the neuroaxis and is often rapidly progressive. Histologically the tumors are highly cellular with nuclear and cellular pleomorphism, endothelial proliferation, mitotic figures, and, often, necrosis. This tumor has a relatively poor prognosis. Clinical features may include pain followed by rapidly progressive neurologic deficits such as extremity weakness, sensory changes, spasticity, and incontinence. (From Innocenzi et al., Clin Neurol Neurosurg 1997 Feb;99(1):1-5)

MONDO:0004365.text: A uveal melanoma characterized by the presence of tumor cell necrosis.

MONDO:0004366.text: A mixed glioma characterized by the presence of astrocytic, ependymal, and oligodendroglial neoplastic components.

MONDO:0004367.text: A meningioma that affects the petroclival region.

MONDO:0004368.text: A meningioma that affects the sphenoorbital region.

MONDO:0004369.text: An infectious disease that involves the kidney.

MONDO:0004370.text: A meningioma that affects the sphenocavernous region.

MONDO:0004371.text: A clear cell meningioma arising in multiple areas of the spinal cord characterized by the presence of clear glycogen-rich polygonal cells.

MONDO:0004372.text: Neuropathy affecting multiple nerves that is caused by prolonged exposure to toxic substances.

MONDO:0004373.text: A papillary meningioma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004374.text: An osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue, and occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004375.text: Long-standing and persistent renal disease with glomerular filtration rate (GFR) less than 15 ml/min.

MONDO:0004376.text: An invasive, non-metastasizing neoplasm with sweat duct differentiation that arises in the area of the nipple. Local recurrences have been reported.

MONDO:0004377.text: A usually malignant neuroendocrine tumor arising from the delta cells of the pancreas. It is not associated with a hormonal syndrome.

MONDO:0004378.text: An embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the cerebral hemispheres and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004379.text: A carcinoma that arises from the breast in females. It is the most common malignant tumor that affects females.

MONDO:0004380.text: A sarcoma that involves the dendritic cell.

MONDO:0004381.text: A non-invasive pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that form a single layer and are well polarized. The neoplastic cells exhibit small and uniform nuclei, mild pleomorphism, and rare mitotic figures.

MONDO:0004382.text: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the larynx. Representative examples include laryngitis, vocal cord polyp, squamous papilloma, and carcinoma.

MONDO:0004383.text: A central nervous system germinoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004384.text: A benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the maxillary sinus. It results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

MONDO:0004385.text: A xanthogranuloma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004386.text: An adenomyoma that arises from the uterine corpus and is characterized by the presence of marked glandular architectural complexity. It may recur following excision.

MONDO:0004387.text: A non-neoplastic and self-limited condition that occurs during pregnancy. It is characterized by proliferation of luteinized stromal cells that replace the normal ovarian stromal cells. It is usually manifested with bilateral multinodular ovarian masses. Treatment is not required.

MONDO:0004389.text: Infestations with arthropods of the subclass acari, superorder Acariformes.

MONDO:0004390.text: Abnormally low intraocular pressure often related to chronic inflammation (uveitis).

MONDO:0004392.text: An extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma arising from the structures within the cranium.

MONDO:0004393.text: A tumor of mixed cell type with astrocytic components as well as ependymoma components.

MONDO:0004394.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the mucosal epithelial surface of the maxillary sinus. Patients may present with nasal fullness, obstruction, and/or epistaxis.

MONDO:0004396.text: A meningioma that arises from the meninges of the cervical region of the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004397.text: A schwannoma that arises from the posterior mediastinum. It is characterized by the presence of psammoma bodies.

MONDO:0004398.text: A schwannoma that arises from the posterior mediastinum. It is the most common neurogenic tumor of the mediastinum. Excision is usually curative.

MONDO:0004400.text: A type A thymoma which is characterized by an aggressive clinical course (capsular invasion, infiltration of the surrounding tissues) and can metastasize.

MONDO:0004401.text: Malignant testicular germ cell tumor that is resistant to treatment.

MONDO:0004402.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of gland-like spaces, irregular alveoli, and tubular structures.

MONDO:0004403.text: A T lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004405.text: An adenocarcinoma arising from Barrett metaplastic epithelium in the esophagus. There is evidence supporting the idea that the Barrett adenocarcinomas develop through a stepwise progression through intestinal metaplastic epithelium to epithelial dysplasia to malignancy. Adenocarcinomas arising in the setting of Barrett esophagus are typically papillary and/or tubular. In terms of grading, they are well or moderately differentiated adenocarcinomas. -- 2002

MONDO:0004406.text: A mixed germ cell tumor of central nervous system that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004407.text: A neuroblastic tumor characterized by the presence of a ganglioneuroblastoma component and the formation of Schwannian stroma which is the predominant component of the tumor volume.

MONDO:0004408.text: A neuroblastic tumor characterized by the presence of a ganglioneuroblastoma component and the formation of Schwannian stroma which constitutes more than fifty-percent of the tumor volume.

MONDO:0004409.text: A carcinoma that develops in the ducts of the nipple.

MONDO:0004410.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis and is characterized by the presence of malignant spindle-shaped cells.

MONDO:0004411.text: A gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the duodenum. It is characterized by the presence of uniform cells that form pseudorosettes. The neoplastic cells have uniform nuclei and small amount of eosinophilic cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004412.text: A very rare, aggressive carcinoma of the sweat glands arising from malignant transformation of a long standing spiradenoma. It usually grows in the upper extremities, lower extremities, trunk, and head and neck. It has the tendency to recur and metastasize most often to the lymph nodes, bones, and lungs.

MONDO:0004413.text: A variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of polygonal squamous cells. Intercellular bridges and cytoplasmic keratinization may be present, but keratin pearls are absent.

MONDO:0004414.text: A spectrum of endometrial abnormalities that occur in women who use tamoxifen to treat or prevent the development of breast cancer. These abnormalities include endometrial polyps, endometrial hyperplasia, and endometrial carcinoma.

MONDO:0004420.text: A rare tumor characterized by malignant transformation of an eccrine spiradenoma of the breast.

MONDO:0004421.text: A breast papilloma characterized by the presence of predominant sclerosing architectural features.

MONDO:0004422.text: A meningioma that affects the falx cerebri.

MONDO:0004423.text: An osteosarcoma arising from the brain or spinal cord.

MONDO:0004425.text: Overactivity of the thyroid gland resulting in overproduction of thyroid hormone and increased metabolic rate. Causes include diffuse hyperplasia of the thyroid gland (Graves' disease), single nodule in the thyroid gland, and thyroiditis. The symptoms are related to the increased metabolic rate and include weight loss, fatigue, heat intolerance, excessive sweating, diarrhea, tachycardia, insomnia, muscle weakness, and tremor.

MONDO:0004426.text: A meningioma that affects the frontal sulcus.

MONDO:0004427.text: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the supraglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0004428.text: A benign, well circumscribed lung neoplasm morphologically characterized by the presence of cystic spaces resembling alveoli, lined by a simple cuboidal epithelium. The cystic spaces are surrounded by a spindle cell stroma which may show myxoid changes. It is a solitary, usually peripheral lung lesion. Patients are usually asymptomatic and its discovery is an incidental finding during chest X-ray examination. Surgical excision is curative.

MONDO:0004429.text: A meningioma (disease) that involves the zone of skin.

MONDO:0004430.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis and is characterized by a mixture of morphologic patterns (e.g., high grade squamous cell carcinoma and verrucous carcinoma or warty-basaloid carcinoma).

MONDO:0004431.text: Bleeding into the joints. It may arise from trauma or spontaneously in patients with hemophilia.

MONDO:0004432.text: A benign teratoma that arises from the pericardium.

MONDO:0004433.text: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis and is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern.

MONDO:0004435.text: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the liver. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0004436.text: A liposarcoma that arises from the ovary and is composed of round to oval mesenchymal cells, small signet ring lipoblasts, and a rich network of capillaries in a myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0004438.text: A carcinoma that arises from the breast and is not caused by inherited genetic mutations.

MONDO:0004439.text: A meningioma that affects the periocular region.

MONDO:0004440.text: A meningioma that affects the pineal gland.

MONDO:0004441.text: An embryonal carcinoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004442.text: A rare malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of embryoid bodies.

MONDO:0004443.text: A parachordoma arising from the chest wall.

MONDO:0004444.text: A rare morphologic variant of bladder carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a tubulo-cystic pattern.

MONDO:0004445.text: A rare morphologic variant of bladder adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a papillary pattern.

MONDO:0004446.text: A meningioma that affects the olfactory sulcus.

MONDO:0004447.text: A meningioma that affects the pituitary stalk.

MONDO:0004448.text: A benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the frontal sinus. It results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

MONDO:0004449.text: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within small breast ducts.

MONDO:0004450.text: A occlusion precerebral artery that involves the carotid artery segment.

MONDO:0004451.text: A rare, aggressive variant of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. It is characterized by the presence of adenocarcinoma cells that are intermingled with malignant pleomorphic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004452.text: A germinoma arising from the central nervous system during childhood.

MONDO:0004453.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of myxomatous tissue that contains collections of malignant cells with prominent nucleoli.

MONDO:0004454.text: A congenital mesoblastic nephroma characterized by increased cellularity, sheet-like proliferation of fibroblastic cells, and increased mitotic activity. Necrotic changes are commonly present.

MONDO:0004455.text: A congenital mesoblastic nephroma characterized by the presence of interlacing fascicles of fibroblastic cells, low mitotic activity, and collagen formation.

MONDO:0004456.text: Disorders related or resulting from use of cocaine.

MONDO:0004457.text: A papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the maxillary sinus. It is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.

MONDO:0004459.text: A hepatoid adenocarcinoma that involves the urinary bladder.

MONDO:0004460.text: A thyroid gland adenoma composed of microfollicular structures.

MONDO:0004461.text: An adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a tubulovillous architectural pattern.

MONDO:0004462.text: A mucinous cystic neoplasm that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.

MONDO:0004463.text: Primary myelofibrosis characterized by bone marrow hypercellularity and the presence of atypical megakaryocytes. There is no increase in the percentage of myeloblasts and no significant increase in reticulin or collagen fibrosis in the bone marrow.

MONDO:0004464.text: A metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urethra. It is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

MONDO:0004465.text: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the periampullary region.

MONDO:0004466.text: A non-neoplastic inflammatory disorder of neurons.

MONDO:0004467.text: A benign teratoma that arises from the stomach.

MONDO:0004468.text: Paget disease involving the squamous epithelium of the anal canal.

MONDO:0004471.text: The inflammation of one or more joints caused by a bacterial infection within the joint space. Symptoms include pain, stiffness, and decreased range of motion in the affected joint.

MONDO:0004472.text: An invasive breast adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of tall columnar neoplastic cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin. Grossly, cystic changes are not identified.

MONDO:0004473.text: A malignant neoplasm that affects the epiglottis. The vast majority of cases are squamous cell carcinomas.

MONDO:0004474.text: A lymphoma that arises from the gallbladder, with the bulk of the tumor located at this site.

MONDO:0004475.text: A rare, usually aggressive, primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of carcinoma cells with clear cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004477.text: A ganglioneuroblastoma arising from the adrenal gland.

MONDO:0004478.text: A recently recognized variant of chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) that lacks somatic hypermutations of the Immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) genes, implying pregerminal center B-cell origin. Microarray gene expression profiling studies have demonstrated the expression of ZAP-70 gene (Syk family tyrosine kinase) in this subset of CLL/CLL. Patients with this variant of CLL/SLL have an unfavorable prognosis compared to those with somatic hypermutations of the IGH genes, with a median survival of approximately 6-8 years.

MONDO:0004479.text: A malignant germ cell tumor that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004481.text: A pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of a focal or multifocal invasive carcinomatous component. The invasive carcinoma is either colloid or ductal adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004482.text: A non-neoplastic soft tissue disorder characterized by the localized formation of reactive fibrous and bone tissues. It usually occurs in the subcutaneous tissue of the proximal phalanx. Less frequently, it involves the toe. It presents with swelling and pain of the affected area. The prognosis is excellent. However, incomplete excision may lead to the re-growth of the lesion.

MONDO:0004483.text: A thyroid gland adenoma composed of large cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

MONDO:0004484.text: A melanoma that arises from the gallbladder.

MONDO:0004485.text: Inflammation of the heart characterized by infiltration of the interstitial tissues by inflammatory cells, histiocytes, and the formation of granulomas. Giant cells are often present.

MONDO:0004486.text: An adenomyoma that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of endocervical mucinous glands and a smooth muscle cell component. There is no atypia or significant mitotic activity present.

MONDO:0004487.text: An adenomyoma that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of endometrial type glands and endometrial stroma, surrounded by smooth muscle. There is no evidence of atypia.

MONDO:0004488.text: An adenomyoma that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of a glandular component exhibiting architectural complexity.

MONDO:0004489.text: A malignant trophoblastic tumor that arises from the fallopian tube during pregnancy.

MONDO:0004491.text: An aggressive malignant tumor arising from trophoblastic cells in the uterus during pregnancy. Approximately half of the cases develop from a complete hydatidiform mole. There is often marked elevation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in the blood. Choriocarcinomas disseminate rapidly through the hematogenous route; the lungs are most frequently affected.

MONDO:0004492.text: An inflammatory process affecting the mediastinum.

MONDO:0004493.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of numerous papillary structures that are lined by cells with prominent nucleoli.

MONDO:0004494.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of hepatoid cells collections.

MONDO:0004495.text: A cataract occurring as a sequela of myotonic dystrophy.

MONDO:0004496.text: Myocarditis is a condition that is characterized by inflammation of the heart muscle (myocardium). Some affected people have no noticeable symptoms of the condition. When present, signs and symptoms may include chest pain, abnormal heartbeat, shortness of breath, fatigue, signs of infection (i.e. fever, headache, sore throat, diarrhea), and leg swelling. Myocarditis can be caused by a variety of factors including infections (viral, bacterial, parasitic, and fungal), allergic reactions to certain medications, and exposure to certain chemicals. It can also be associated with other inflammatory conditions such as lupus, Wegener's granulomatosis, giant cell arteritis and Takayasu's arteritis. Most cases occur sporadically in people with no family history of the condition. Treatment aims to address the underlying cause of the condition. Medications and rarely, a heart transplant may be needed if the heart muscle becomes weak.

MONDO:0004497.text: A stage of syphilis that occurs fifteen to thirty years after the initial infection; it can include gumma formation and cardiovascular or central nervous system involvement (neurosyphilis).

MONDO:0004498.text: A meningioma that arises from the meninges of the sacral region of the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004499.text: A lung carcinoma arising from the hilum of the lung.

MONDO:0004500.text: A carcinoma originating from the apical lung. Most superior sulcus lung carcinomas are bronchogenic carcinomas. This carcinoma may be associated with Pancoast syndrome. lt is also known as Pancoast tumor.

MONDO:0004501.text: A rare, benign, asymptomatic neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube. The tumors are round and solitary and contain connective tissue and cystic structures lined by serous-type epithelium. The majority of cases are incidental findings during operation for an unrelated gynecologic disorder.

MONDO:0004503.text: A meningioma that affects the upper clivus.

MONDO:0004504.text: A urethra cancer that involves the penis.

MONDO:0004505.text: A benign papillary neoplasm that arises in a large duct of the breast. It is characterized by the presence of a fibrovascular core that is lined by benign epithelial and myoepithelial proliferations. Patients usually present with nipple discharge.

MONDO:0004506.text: A benign papillary neoplasm that arises in a terminal ductal lobular unit. It is characterized by the presence of a fibrovascular core that is lined by benign epithelial and myoepithelial proliferations. Peripheral breast papillomas are often multiple and are usually found microscopically. Patients are often asymptomatic.

MONDO:0004507.text: An intraductal papilloma of the breast characterized by the presence of focal epithelial atypia.

MONDO:0004508.text: Inflammation of the periapical tissue. It includes general, unspecified, or acute nonsuppurative inflammation. Chronic nonsuppurative inflammation is periapical granuloma. Suppurative inflammation is periapical abscess.

MONDO:0004509.text: A non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the intrahepatic bile ducts.

MONDO:0004510.text: A rare morphologic variant of well differentiated liposarcoma occurring most often in the retroperitoneum. It is characterized by the presence of a predominant inflammatory infiltrate composed of lymphoplasmacytic aggregates.

MONDO:0004511.text: A meningioma that affects the lower clivus.

MONDO:0004512.text: A meningeal melanoma with secondary diffuse meningeal spread. (WHO)

MONDO:0004513.text: An aggressive rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in adults. The neoplasm is characterized by the presence of bizarre round, spindle, and polygonal cells. Clinical presentation includes a rapidly enlarging painful mass usually in the lower extremities.

MONDO:0004514.text: Chronic inflammation of the nasal cavity mucosa. It may lead to post-nasal drip resulting in chronic sore throat and chronic cough.

MONDO:0004517.text: A tuberculosis that involves the ureter.

MONDO:0004518.text: A malignant neoplasm that affects the portion of the urethra that is close to the outside of the body.

MONDO:0004519.text: A rare hemangioma arising from synovium lining surfaces.

MONDO:0004520.text: Stage 0 includes: pTis, N0, M0, S0. pTis: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia (carcinoma in situ). N0: regional lymph node metastasis. M0: No distant metastasis. S0: Marker study levels within normal limits. (AJCC 6th and 7th eds.)

MONDO:0004521.text: An epithelioid sarcoma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004522.text: Inflammation of the peritoneum due to infection by bacteria or fungi. Causes include liver disease, perforation of the gastrointestinal tract or biliary tract, and peritoneal dialysis. Patients usually present with abdominal pain and tenderness, fever, chills, and nausea and vomiting. It is an emergency medical condition that requires prompt medical attention and treatment.

MONDO:0004523.text: A squamous cell carcinoma of the skin with a prominent clear cell component.

MONDO:0004524.text: A thyroid gland adenoma with increased cellularity and nuclear atypia. There is no capsular or vascular invasion. The clinical course is benign.

MONDO:0004525.text: A contagious skin infection that is caused by the burrowing parasitic mite, Sarcoptes scabiei, and is characterized by intense itching and small, raised red spots in the area of the mite burrows.

MONDO:0004526.text: A benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm of the uterine corpus. Representative examples include leiomyoma, leiomyosarcoma, and endometrial stromal sarcoma.

MONDO:0004528.text: A myofibroblastoma arising from the inguinal lymph nodes. It is characterized by the presence of nuclear palisading.

MONDO:0004529.text: A rare soft tissue tumor of uncertain lineage characterized by the presence of neoplastic spindle to round cells forming cords in a fibromyxoid stroma. Metaplastic bone formation is not present.

MONDO:0004530.text: A cervical adenocarcinoma with minimal stromal invasion. The risk of local lymph node metastasis is insignificant and the prognosis is excellent.

MONDO:0004531.text: Breast adenosis characterized by the proliferation of acini, a lobulated architectural pattern, and stromal sclerosis. The luminal epithelial and myopepithelial cells are preserved. Microcalcifications and foci of apocrine metaplasia may be present.

MONDO:0004532.text: A malignant neoplasm involving the auditory system

MONDO:0004533.text: A hemangioma arising from perineural tissues.

MONDO:0004534.text: A rare variant of breast adenosis characterized by the proliferation of small round glands in a collagenous stroma. The epithelial cells are cuboidal and there are no myopepithelial cells present. There is no evidence of atypia.

MONDO:0004535.text: A non-gestational choriocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004537.text: A cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma that resembles the large intestinal adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004538.text: A cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells that resemble those of the endocervix.

MONDO:0004539.text: A cancer that involves the aorta.

MONDO:0004540.text: A rare variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor composed predominantly or exclusively of epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004541.text: A morphologic variant of testicular seminoma characterized by the presence of seminoma cells arranged in pseudoglandular patterns and few lymphocytes.

MONDO:0004542.text: A poorly differentiated variant of adenosquamous carcinoma that arises from the cervix. It is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells with ground glass cytoplasm and stromal eosinophilic infiltrates.

MONDO:0004543.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of immature glands.

MONDO:0004544.text: A WHO grade II, usually recurring meningioma characterized by the predominance of tissues that are histologically similar to chordoma.

MONDO:0004545.text: A malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor occurring during adulthood.

MONDO:0004546.text: A neoplasm (disease) that involves the lumbar nerve plexus.

MONDO:0004547.text: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of a meshwork of small vacuolated cells resulting in a honeycomb appearance.

MONDO:0004548.text: A rare sex cord-stromal tumor that arises from the testis in adults. Gynecomastia is present in approximately a quarter of the patients. Several morphologic patterns have been identified and include insular, gyriform, trabecular, pseudosarcomatous, and solid. Metastases occur in approximately twenty percent of the cases.
